triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: stays `area:ai` · `domain:server` · `priority:p1` · `pm:queue` as filed; type set to Task. Rationale: it carries the RAGFlow half of p1 #36839, by the maintainer's ruling 7134290286 (option R1).

On the lane-split question (mailbox #36743, 7134418231): no area split. Every surface it touches is the retirement of one package, and repo:objectstack#4 holds area:ai p1 under the maintainer's routing. The split that matters is the merge tier:
- `skills/**` (the `objectstack-ai` SKILL.md example and the eval) and `.github/workflows/lint.yml` are governed Tier H surfaces (`check-governed-merges.mjs`). A PR touching them waits for the Tier H approver.
- The package, settings, spec comments, docs and scripts are not governed.

So the seat chooses, under this one card, between:
- one Tier H PR, as the ruling's "one PR" reads; or
- a Tier S PR for the package and the rest, followed by a Tier H PR for the skill, the eval and the lint.yml comment, landed back to back so the skill never outlives the package.

If the lint.yml comment can simply stay true, leaving it out keeps that surface out of the PR.

Kept as written: CHANGELOGs, release notes, `docs/audits/**`, `docs/adr/**`, existing `.changeset/*.md`. Stop on breach and report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:thread`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER — dispatch-gates --tier: "MANDATORY ... skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md ⇢ 'skills/**' — clause ①"`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no

Responsibility: objectstack platform code, `packages/plugins/knowledge-ragflow`: an adapter that does not match the RAGFlow API, taught as production-ready by docs and the skill | none: no platform path makes it work | any app author or agent following the docs; no consumer in this repo today
Thread-read: 7182590079
Premise: holds — on `origin/main` `7d50dc8bbd`: `git grep -il ragflow` (history paths excluded) still hits the package (4 files), `service-settings` (14), `service-knowledge` (3), `packages/spec/src` (3), docs, the skill and its evals, 8 scripts, `lint.yml`, `.changeset/config.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Blocker PR #37265 merged 2026-11-26T00:30Z; sibling PR #36850 (ruling option B) merged. Seat 4 yielded the card (7182590079).
Serial constraints cleared: overlap-check on a probe branch over the planned files (exit 1) names only #35129, the Version Packages release PR (changeset-release/main), which regenerates after each merge. No sibling work PR overlaps, and no other in-flight claim touches `knowledge-ragflow`, `service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge*` or `skills/objectstack-ai/**`.
Pre-claim lane: mixed surface, kept in one PR by ruling R1; `domain:server` (the package, settings), plus `skills/**` (governed) and the `lint.yml` comment (governed) ⇒ Tier H, L2 at the contract tier
Pre-claim deps: `Blocked-by: #37265` merged; #36850 merged
Prior rulings read: ruling 7134290286 on #36839 (R1 + B, the maintainer's 「RAGFlow 我倾向于作废」 / 「同意，RAGFlow 也按 R1 和 B 执行」) binds scope and "one PR"; `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` immediate retirement; `knowledge-source.zod.ts` `adapter: z.string()` (no protocol value narrowed). The card's acceptance measurements (a) settings page with a stored `ragflow` adapter, (b) an unregistered adapter at boot or first use are owed in the PR body; a silent (b) becomes a seat-filed card, not a fix here.

Why: the card thread measured that the diff narrows a settings accept set at a public door. `PUT /api/settings/knowledge {adapter:'ragflow'}` now answers 400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION (invalid_option), and a write of any `ragflow_*` key answers 400 UNKNOWN_KEY; both answered 200 before. This follows the in-tree precedents `.changeset/33933-knowledge-settings-with-service.md` and `.changeset/37098-knowledge-splitter.md`: the change stays a patch (ruling 7134290286: "no major"), the PR title carries `!` with a BREAKING paragraph, and the dogfood battery runs on the final head. One contract-tier L2 is owed before the queue, which the `skills/**` surface already required.
